blocks.prompt: 1. Find the sum of first 15 terms of the geometric sequence \(1, \frac{1}{3}, \frac{1}{9}, \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Humein G.P. ke pehle 15 terms ka sum chahiye.
Plan: \(a_1\) parhenge, \(r\) nikalenge, aur \(S_n = \frac{a_1(1 - r^{n})}{1 - r}\) lagayenge (yeh shakal \(r < 1\) par aasan rehti hai). Aakhir mein 3 ki powers ka hisaab karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: G.P. \(1, \frac{1}{3}, \frac{1}{9}, \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(S_{15}\), yani pehle 15 terms ka sum.
Tareeqa: G.P. ke \(n\) terms ka sum \(S_n = \frac{a_1(1 - r^{n})}{1 - r}\), \(r \neq 1\). Pandrah terms ek ek kar ke jama karna lamba kaam hai; formula seedha jawab deta hai.

\(a_1\), \(r\), \(n\) nikalein
\[a_1 = 1,\ \ r = \dfrac{1/3}{1} = \dfrac{1}{3},\ \ n = 15\]
Kyun: Common ratio \(r\) = agla term taqseem pichla term. Doosre jore se bhi wohi aata hai: \(\frac{1/9}{1/3} = \frac{1}{3}\). Har term pichle ka teesra hissa hai.

Formula mein qeematein rakhein
\[S_{15} = \dfrac{1\left[1 - \left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{15}\right]}{1 - \frac{1}{3}}\]
\[= \dfrac{3}{2}\left(1 - \dfrac{1}{3^{15}}\right)\]
Kyun: Neeche \(1 - \frac{1}{3} = \frac{2}{3}\). Kisi fraction se divide karna us ko ulta kar ke multiply karna hai, is liye \(\frac{3}{2}\) aaya.
Dhyan dein: \(\left(\frac{1}{3}\right)^{15} = \frac{1}{3^{15}}\); power upar aur neeche dono par lagti hai, lekin \(1^{15} = 1\) hi rehta hai.

Ek fraction banayein
\[S_{15} = \dfrac{3}{2} \cdot \dfrac{3^{15} - 1}{3^{15}}\]
\[= \dfrac{3^{15} - 1}{2 \cdot 3^{14}}\]
Kyun: Bracket ke andar common denominator \(3^{15}\) liya. Phir upar wala 3 neeche ke \(3^{15}\) mein se ek 3 cancel kar deta hai, \(3^{14}\) bachta hai.

3 ki powers nikalein
\[3^{14} = 4782969\]
\[3^{15} - 1 = 14348907 - 1 = 14348906\]
Kyun: Qadam ba qadam: \(3^{7} = 2187\), phir \(3^{14} = 2187 \times 2187 = 4782969\), aur \(3^{15} = 3 \times 4782969 = 14348907\). Is tarah bari power bhi aasani se nikal aati hai.

Simplify karein
\[S_{15} = \dfrac{14348906}{2 \times 4782969}\]
\[= \dfrac{7174453}{4782969}\]
Kyun: Upar wala number even hai, is liye neeche ke 2 se cancel kar ke upar ko aadha kar diya: \(14348906 \div 2 = 7174453\).

Tasdeeq: jawab ka andaza
\[S_{15} \approx 1.4999999\]
Kyun: Agar saare (la-mehdood) terms jama karein to sum \(\frac{1}{1 - 1/3} = 1.5\) banta hai. 15 terms ka sum us se zara sa kam hona chahiye, aur aisa hi hai. Terms itni tezi se chhote hote hain ke 15 terms mein hi sum 1.5 ke bilkul qareeb pohanch jata hai.
